course.title: jQuery — From Beginner to Professional
course.description: A visual-first, project-based jQuery 4.0.0 course covering all 193 topics across the supplied 22-module curriculum: setup, core APIs, selectors, traversal, DOM manipulation, events, effects, forms, AJAX, asynchronous workflows, utilities, plugins, security, performance, testing, ecosystem integration, migration, and production practices.
course.version_scope: jQuery 4.0.0 is the stable learning baseline listed on the official Download page and official release post, checked 2026-10-12. Teach current APIs first. Removed and deprecated methods belong only in explicitly labeled migration lessons. Use the full build for lessons relying on AJAX/effects; the slim build omits those modules.
prerequisites: Basic HTML document structure and forms
JavaScript variables, functions, arrays, objects and callbacks
Basic browser DevTools and HTTP/JSON concepts
learning_outcomes: Select DOM elements and use jQuery collections, traversal, and manipulation APIs correctly.
Build responsive interactive components with accessible event handling, form validation, and controlled effects.
Integrate HTTP/JSON APIs with clear loading, success, error, cancellation, and authentication boundaries.
Organize reusable behavior and plugins, test UI and asynchronous behavior, and diagnose browser issues.
Review performance, security, accessibility, dependencies, and compatibility; plan a tested migration to jQuery 4 where appropriate.
